key_fiscal_facts.value_text: 22% ordinary corporate income tax (skattesats for alminnelig inntekt). Separate from 71.8% Special Petroleum Tax (SPT). CIT+SPT combined = 78% marginal rate. CIT applies shelf-wide on all income from Norwegian Continental Shelf.
None (abolished 1986 for new acreage); legacy fields may have historic obligations
56% Special Petroleum Tax (Petroleumsskatteloven Section 5, post-2022 reform). Applied after uplift deduction (5.2%/yr x 4yr = 20.8% of CAPEX). CIT 22% separate. Combined = 78%.

SDFI (Statens direkte okonomiske engasjement) varies 20-80% per license block; Equinor manages SDFI on behalf of state. Average SDFI share approximately 30-40% across NCS. Model at net IOC working interest after SDFI back-in. SDFI pays proportional share of costs and receives proportional production revenues.
